issue.title: fix(governance): reject empty Mainnet evidence packs
issue.body:
## Summary

Hardens the Mainnet Acceptance Evidence Pack gate. Previously `branch_promotion_policy.py` only checked that the 6 `####` headings were PRESENT — the auto-generated body leaves them as "Complete before review" placeholders and still passed. Now each heading must have non-placeholder content, so a staged->main promotion cannot merge with an unfilled evidence pack.

### Feature -> dev promotion checklist

PROMOTION:FEATURE->DEV

- [x] Policy logic change with focused test coverage.
- [x] Empty and placeholder evidence packs are now rejected.

issue.title: ci(auto-promotion): disable auto-merge; require manual review
issue.body:
## Summary

Promotion PRs were auto-merging once only the lightweight `Enforce branch promotion rules` check passed, even when real CI (DKG ceremony, WASM runtime lanes, etc.) was failing and the Mainnet acceptance evidence pack was unfilled. This removes `gh pr ready` + `gh pr merge --auto` so promotion candidates stay as **DRAFT** and require explicit human review/merge. The autopull stale-close / update-branch logic is preserved.

### Feature -> dev promotion checklist

PROMOTION:FEATURE->DEV

- [x] CI workflow change only; no runtime code or behavior change.
- [x] Promotion candidates now require explicit human merge; auto-merge removed.

issue.title: docs: reconcile repository taxonomy to current org inventory
issue.body:
## Summary
`docs/REPOSITORY_TAXONOMY.md` listed 5 repositories that no longer exist (HTTP 404) and omitted 3 active repositories.

## Changes
- **Marked as Deprecated (deleted — HTTP 404):** `Conxian/Conxian`, `conxian_ui`, `conxius-orbit`, `elizaos-plugin-conxian`, `demo-repository`.
- **Added missing active repos:** `conxian_market` (market/settlement), `conxian.github.io` (GitHub Pages), `conxian-org-site` (MDX org site, conxian.org).
- Moved deleted repos from the active narrative taxonomy into a `Deprecated / deleted repositories (historical)` section.
- Updated the transitional-states register entry for `demo-repository` to `Historical context / Deleted`.

## Verification
Org inventory now matches GitHub (`GET /orgs/Conxian/repos` → 13 active repos, 0 archived).

> This PR was created by an AI agent (OpenHands) on behalf of the maintainers.
